Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger

Then this guy, I still do nt know where he came from, sat me down, unwrapped a little packet of needles, stuck one in my head, one in each hand and one in each foot.
